question: The distance between two stations, Delhi and Amritsar is 450 km. A train starts at 4 p.m. from Delhi and moves towards Amritsar at an average speed of 60 km/h. Another train starts from Amritsar at 3:20 p.m. and moves towards Delhi at an average speed of 80 km/h. At what distance from Delhi will the two trains meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between Delhi and Amritsar = 450 km

Time of departure from Delhi = 4 p.m.

Speed of the train (from Delhi ) = 60 km/h

Time of departure from Amritsar = 3:20 p.m.

Speed of the train (from Amritsar ) = 80 km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distanceover Time

**Calculation:**

Let x represent how far from Delhi will two trains meet

Train from Amritsar started 40 minutes early = 40over 60 h

Distance covered in (40)/(60) h = {80times} {40over60}

= 160over3 km

Distance left to cover = 450 - {160over3}

= {1190over3 }km

Now, to reach the meeting point both trains will take equal time.

 xover60 = {{1190over3}-x}over80

​xover60 = 1190-3xover240​

4x = 1190 - 3x

4x + 3x = 1190

7x = 1190

x = 1190over7

x = 170

Time taken by train from Delhi to cover 170 km = 170over60 = 2.8 h = 2 hours 48 minutes

Time when both trains meet = 4:00 + 2:48 = 6:48 PM

**Therefore, the trains will meet at 170km from delhi and at 6:48 p.m.**
